name: Status Acknowledgment
sourceRefs: cosyte/ncpdp src/script/response.ts (ResponseFields: code?, descriptionCode?, description?; extractResponse() reads Code/DescriptionCode/Description identically for Status/Error/Verify) -- cross-confirmed against usnistgov/tcamt-2's SCRIPT_XML_10_6.xsd own <Status> element (Code with pattern 000|001|002|003|005|010, DescriptionCode 0..10, Description 0..1). A positive acknowledgment of a prior transaction -- the SCRIPT analogue of X12's own 999 functional acknowledgment, matching that transaction's own precedent of engine support without a FHIR mapping (a transport-layer ack has no natural FHIR resource analogue).

DescriptionCode's real maxOccurs is 10 per the XSD, but this engine's own field model (like cosyte/ncpdp's own extraction) reads only the first occurrence -- a named simplification matching cosyte's own precedent, not a schema-engine limitation.
